description: This file defines an enumeration 'GatewayConnectionIssue' representing various types of connection problems encountered in gateway communication. It includes methods for analyzing status text to detect issue types and extract request IDs.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionIssue
classes.description: An enumeration representing specific gateway connection issues, with associated data for certain cases.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Analyzes a status text string to determine the specific connection issue type.

methods.name: requestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID if the issue is pairing required.

methods.name: needsAuthToken
methods.description: Indicates whether an authentication token is needed for the issue.

methods.name: needsPairing
methods.description: Indicates whether pairing is required for the issue.
